statement_pin_required.convention: Fix n : ℕ, d : Fin n → ℕ nonincreasing. IsGraphic d := ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n), ∀ i, G.degree i = d i. reduce d deletes the max-degree entry, decrements the next (d 0) entries, re-sorts nonincreasing. Claim: IsGraphic d ↔ IsGraphic (reduce d), with failed reduction (negative / d 0 ≥ n) ⇒ ¬ IsGraphic d. Encoding: Mathlib degree on Fin n. Existence only — not isomorphism classes.
landmines: Simple graphs only. d i ≤ n-1 is necessary; d 0 ≥ n is immediately non-graphic.
Even sum is necessary, not sufficient. (2,2,0,0) is the landmine. Handshaking already in DegreeSum.lean.
Not Erdős–Gállai. Not Gale–Ryser. Not Tutte.
Not greedy / Brooks / Vizing / 4CT. Degree sequence ≠ chromatic number.
n=0 empty graphic; (1) on n=1 not graphic; constant n-1 is ⊤.
Do not re-prime greedy / Brooks / König / Dirac / Eulerian / Dilworth.
